items.reason: ETB 'sacrifice it unless {G} was spent to cast it' modeled as triggered(Enters, IsSelf) + ConditionalEffect{Condition: manaSpentToCast(Color:G, WasSpent:false), Then: sacrifice(It)} — timing lives in the trigger not the effect, WasSpent:false is the 'unless' negation (fact-lookup, not a payable UnlessClause), no free-text/unparsed residual, Flash + shroud siblings faithful; all cited CR rules exist and match

new discriminator is a Condition kind (ConditionKind manaSpentToCast) — not one of the four PortWalk dispatch dimensions (effectType/costType/triggerEvent/restriction) the exhaustiveness ratchet enumerates, so no projection entry is required; the enclosing 'conditional' effectType is already projected and recurses Then->sacrifice, preserving flow reach of the sacrifice port; no insensible coarse parking
